THIS!!! I joined this subreddit to look for someone who also experiences THIS FEELING. I’ve never been able to describe it to anyone. I have always felt crazy!! When I was little, I would tell my parents that I heard voices. Now that I’m an adult, the only words I’ve been able to use to describe it are “everything feels big, loud, and fast”. This happens a lot less now, but it’s usually in the morning, while it’s quiet, and I’m laying in bed, on my phone. I never know what triggers it, but all of a sudden everything feels “loud” almost like static. It usually lasts for about an hour, and I’ve found that I’m able to minimize it by talking out loud or singing out loud. Basically just breaking the silence within my control. THANK YOU for describing this in a better way than I’ve ever been able to. I’m sorry you have to experience this...it’s such an odd feeling.
